rules.sectionReferenceMeaning: Stable XML paragraph ordinal within its book; never a Niese section.
rules.textTransformations: Remove only verified num labels and trim citation-unit edge whitespace. Preserve all literal running characters, spelling, punctuation, and internal whitespace. Empty unclear gains the reader's dagger glyph.
rules.editorialMarkup: Retain del and supplied letters as searchable visible text; preserve their distinct editorial status in UTF-16 editorialMarks. No brackets or separating spaces are inserted into words.
rules.cruxRepresentation: Each empty unclear contributes one explicitly mapped generated †. It represents a crux, not an inferred lacuna. Remove only these mapped glyphs to recover source text.
rules.pageAndLineMarkers: pb and lb contribute no characters and no spaces; word-internal page breaks remain joined. The source lb elements mark division ends.
rules.gapsAndUnknownContent: No main-text gap, note, apparatus, choice, or foreign elements occur in the accepted source. Unknown body markup stops extraction for review.
rules.phraseBoundaries: Ordinary consecutive citation units and chapters are joinable in whole-book scope. Book I's Prologue-to-narrative transition has breakBefore=true. Distinct books are never joined.
rules.offsetDefinition: Audit source/recordText/display offsets are zero-based Python Unicode-character offsets, end exclusive, into concatenated parsed XML paragraph text or displayed record text as named. Record editorialMarks use JavaScript UTF-16 offsets.
rules.sourceProjectionDefinition: Concatenate only source-text segments from the final indexed record; omit only generated-crux segments. Compatibility indexedNonWhitespaceContentSha256 describes this reversible source projection, not the extra publication glyphs.
rules.tokenCountDefinition: Unicode L/N start, L/M/N continuation; original word strings without normalization or stemming.
rules.readerRouteEvidence: assets/js/renderTei.js: DEH uses chapter-local URL units, num labels and Ussani by default; prologue chapter is 0.

coverage.rangeMeaning: stable XML paragraph ordinal, not Niese

excluded.reason: empty marker; contributes no characters or word break
